plan.diagnosis_summary: Node_1 shows three recoverable faults: residual aliases for djit/synack/ackdat, 412 corrupted rows, and x1000 inflation of sbytes/dbytes/dload. collector_tag_score is a local shortcut on node_3 (MI_norm 1.0002 vs <=0.0084 on peers) and should be dropped globally; node_2/3/4 otherwise pass schema, row-health, and conservation checks, with node_4's shifts attributable to legitimate rare-class Non-IID.
